scope: Focused review of completed C41 results using local immutable inputs; no original source, receipt, baseline or comparison edited
purpose_declared_before_measurement: Simplification with correctness and no material incremental core/serving performance regression versus BOTH C40 boots; no speed gain required
materiality_basis: The predeclared acceptance explicitly included engine cost and cold/mixed prefill and required no material core regression surviving paired and repeat floors.
Existing with_floor uses CI95 plus absolute repeat change for non-paired rows, separately preserving candidate and saved-reference repeats. No new percentage tolerance is introduced.

Grid cost is adverse in all four raw boot pairings and exceeds the existing margin in seven of eight pair-by-floor views. The smallest pairing does not clear the saved-reference repeat margin; preserve it as same.
Cold 524K throughput is adverse in all four raw pairings and exceeds both floor margins for both C41 boots against C40 repeat boot: four worse views, four same views.
There was no predeclared de-minimis waiver that would permit calling these beyond-margin core costs harmless after measurement. Neutral aggregate decode alone does not satisfy the broader criterion.

primary_C40_comparison.view_count_limit: Eight views are not eight independent experiments; two candidate and two reference boots remain the actual evidence.

minimum_available_host_memory_gib.limit: Both remain above the native guard; allocation/boot attribution is unproven.

other_adverse_observations.tail_limit: Percentile intervals were not recorded; preserve these observations without asserting statistical proof.

source_causality_review.grid: engine_grid calls _dummy_run, target and DSpark forwards; it bypasses CopyDrafter.prepare_alloc/propose. Removing readiness machinery does not directly explain the measured grid cost. This is an attribution limit, not permission to discard the image-level cost.
source_causality_review.pure_cold_prefill: Harness sends max_tokens=1. Scheduler._drafts_unused skips nonfinal prefill drafting and drafts whose next verification cannot occur; skip_drafts resolves K=0 in the V2 runner and bypasses the changed preparation. Existing sink/inflight branches prevent claiming this from max_tokens alone for arbitrary traffic. No recorded trace establishes preparation as the cold-prefill regression cause.
source_causality_review.eligible_real_postprocess: For traffic that actually drafts, moving copy match/allocation onto the model stream can expose work before DSpark rather than overlap it. There is no measured copy-phase timing that bounds a narrow correction above the repeat floors.
source_causality_review.unchanged_inputs: The original source review preserves byte/AST proof that copy kernels, integer/float state policy, default behavior, safe envelope, older ring/D2H delivery, configuration and PR878 guard did not change.
source_causality_review.correction_verdict: No defensible new source correction is justified by this evidence. Do not invent a speculative retry. Restoring removed overlap returns to already measured C40; retain its saved evidence without rebuild or remeasurement.
source_causality_review.withdrawn_proposal: Earlier readiness-event reuse remained unimplemented/unmeasured and is not a second failed benchmark.
